answer: Pay for exposure, not just enforcement. Every identity contributes a small levy into a duplication-bounty pool. Anyone who proves two identities share one operator — same funding trail, same control-plane fingerprint — claims the bounty, which exceeds both identities' rewards. The sybil farmer's old fable of the invisible crowd collapses: each new ghost on the knoll is another ticket the grove's watchers are eager to win. The more fakes planted, the richer the bounty hunting them becomes — the attack funds its own detection.
